reason: The free one-pager costs me nothing but my phone number, and this time the money is tied to a test written down before he starts instead of reports about clicks. After the agency, that is the only kind of offer I will even read.
objection: The written test is only worth something if I trust him to write a real one and not a test he can pass without anything changing in my week. And $2,500 is real money for a one-truck shop having a slow month.
would_change_my_mind: The one-pager turning up late or generic, all talk about clicks and impressions and nothing about the quotes I am eating, or him dodging when I ask what exactly the test measures and who signs off on it.
